mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in TRANSIT mobility over four weeks signals persistent avoidance of public transport, reducing incidental retail exposure during commutes and errands, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -4.1% to -20.7% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -15% for all four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -20% and RESIDENTIAL rises above +6%, consumers shift to home-based activities and online shopping, suppressing retail foot traffic. This substitution effect drives RETAIL_REC negative over the next two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases relative to the prior 14 days when both TRANSIT < -20% and RESIDENTIAL > +6% are simultaneously observed.
